instruction: How to show tc filter by parent
output: tc filter show dev eth0 parent 1:

instruction: How to show tc class by parent
output: tc class show dev eth0 parent 1:

instruction: How to show qdisc statistics
output: tc -s qdisc show dev eth0

instruction: How to show class statistics
output: tc -s class show dev eth0

instruction: How to show filter statistics
output: tc -s filter show dev eth0

instruction: How to add a BPF filter in tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: bpf obj myfilter.o flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a direct-action BPF filter
output: tc filter add dev eth0 ingress bpf obj myfilter.o section prog

instruction: How to compile a BPF program for tc
output: clang -O2 -target bpf -c myfilter.c -o myfilter.o

instruction: How to attach a clsact qdisc for BPF
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 clsact

instruction: How to attach a BPF program to clsact
output: tc filter add dev eth0 ingress bpf da obj mysection.o sec classifier

instruction: How to remove a BPF filter from clsact
output: tc filter del dev eth0 ingress

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching on MAC
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower dst_mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching VLAN ID
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol 802.1q parent 1: flower vlan_id 100 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching MPLS
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol mpls_uc parent 1: flower mpls_label 100 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching IPv4
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching TCP port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower ip_proto tcp dst_port 80 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for matching UDP port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower ip_proto udp dst_port 53 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter with two actions
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action mirred egress redirect dev eth1 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter to sample packets
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action sample group 1 rate 100 trunc 128

instruction: How to add a flower filter to police traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action police rate 1mbit burst 10k conform-exceed drop/ok

instruction: How to add a flower filter to set DSCP
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower dst_ip 192.168.1.0/24 action skbedit priority 5 action mirred egress redirect dev eth1

instruction: How to add a flower filter with VLAN push action
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1: flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action vlan push id 100 priority 7 action mirred egress redirect dev eth1

instruction: How to add a flower filter with VLAN pop action
output: tc filter add dev eth0 protocol 802.1q parent 1: flower vlan_id 100 action vlan pop action mirred egress redirect dev eth1

instruction: How to add a matchall filter
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: matchall action drop

instruction: How to add a matchall filter for policing
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: matchall action police rate 10mbit burst 100k conform-exceed drop/ok
